name: A. Monitoring: OpenPLC Modbus -> MQTT (sorting/status/#)
info: Edit host/port of the "OpenPLC" Modbus client (default: Windows laptop 192.168.18.47, port 1502 = Modbus server defined in the OpenPLC Editor project) and the "Mosquitto" broker if they are not on this machine.

name: PLC link: connected
func:
if (flow.get('plc') !== 'connected') { flow.set('plc', 'connected'); return {topic: 'sorting/system/plc', payload: 'connected'}; }
return null;

name: PLC link: disconnected
func:
if (flow.get('plc') !== 'disconnected') { flow.set('plc', 'disconnected'); return {topic: 'sorting/system/plc', payload: 'disconnected'}; }
return null;
